issues.t: Tow hitch wiring module can short and catch fire (recall)
issues.sym: A burning smell or smoke from the rear of the vehicle, possibly while parked and switched off, on models with the tow hitch harness.
issues.why: Moisture and debris can reach the circuit board in the tow hitch harness module and cause a short.
issues.next: Park outside and away from buildings until the recall repair is done, and book it with a Hyundai dealer right away.

issues.t: Excessive wind noise at highway speed
issues.sym: A whistle or rushing sound around the windshield, mirrors, or front doors at speed.
issues.why: Owners point to door and glass seals that do not sit tightly enough on early vehicles.
issues.next: It is not a safety issue. Ask the dealer to check the door seals and windshield moulding at your next visit.

issues.t: Seat belt buckles may not latch (recall)
issues.sym: A front or second-row outboard seat belt clicks in but pulls free, or will not latch at all.
issues.why: The buckle assemblies for the driver, front passenger, and second-row window seats can fail to hold the latch plate.
issues.next: Check the VIN for the recall. Push each belt in firmly and tug it to confirm it holds, and have the buckles replaced as soon as parts are available.

issues.t: Third-row side curtain airbags may not deploy correctly (recall)
issues.sym: No day-to-day symptom; the concern is how the rear part of the curtain airbag opens in a crash.
issues.why: The third-row section of the side curtain airbag can deploy improperly around the rear window area.
issues.next: Check the VIN for the recall and have the interim or final repair done soon, especially if you carry passengers in the third row.

issues.t: Brake booster can leak vacuum and reduce brake assist (recall)
issues.sym: The brake pedal suddenly feels hard and the vehicle takes longer to stop; you may hear a hiss when pressing the pedal.
issues.why: The diaphragm inside the brake booster can be out of position and let vacuum escape.
issues.next: Check the VIN for the recall. If the pedal turns hard, stop driving and have the booster inspected right away.

issues.t: Idle stop-start oil pump controller can overheat and catch fire (recall)
issues.sym: A burning smell or smoke from under the hood, warning lights, or the stop-start system quitting.
issues.why: The electronic controller for the oil pump used by the idle stop-and-go system may contain damaged components that overheat.
issues.next: Park outside and away from buildings until the recall inspection is done, and schedule it right away.

issues.t: Front passenger airbag may switch off with someone seated (recall)
issues.sym: The passenger airbag off light shows even with an adult in the seat, on vehicles with the dark suede seat trim.
issues.why: The occupant detection software can fail to recognise a person sitting on that seat material.
issues.next: Check the VIN for the recall and have the software updated soon. Seat adults in the rear if the off light is showing.

issues.sym: Sudden loss of power, heavy shaking, loud engine noise, or the engine shutting off while driving.
issues.why: Some valve springs were made incorrectly and can fracture, which can let a valve drop and punch through the engine block.
issues.next: Check the VIN for the recall. If the engine starts running rough or loses power, pull over safely and have it towed.

issues.t: Electric oil pump controller can let in moisture and catch fire (recall)
issues.sym: A burning smell or smoke from under the hood, possibly with warning lights.
issues.why: The seal on the electric oil pump controller may not keep water off its circuit board, which can then short out.
issues.next: Park outside and away from buildings until the controller is replaced under the recall, and book the repair right away.

issues.t: Power-folding rear seats may not stop when someone is in the way (recall)
issues.sym: On top trims, the second- or third-row power seats keep moving after touching a person or object.
issues.why: The seat control software may not detect contact and stop the seat as it folds or slides.
issues.next: Keep children clear of the rear seats while they are moving, and get the software update over the air or at a dealer right away.

issues.t: Third-row seat belt reminder may not warn of an unbuckled belt (recall)
issues.sym: The display shows the third-row driver-side belt as fastened even when it is not.
issues.why: Wiring inside that seat belt buckle can be damaged, leaving the sensor stuck on the buckled signal.
issues.next: Check the VIN for the recall and confirm by hand that third-row passengers are buckled until it is repaired.

issues.t: Instrument panel display can go blank (recall)
issues.sym: The digital gauge screen fails to show speed or warning lights.
issues.why: A software error can cause the instrument display to stop working.
issues.next: Check the VIN for the recall and get the software update over the air or at a dealer soon. Restart the vehicle if the display is blank before driving.
